title: hieracium villosum subsp. villosiceps
intro: Hieracium villosum subsp. villosiceps, commonly known as a type of hawkweed, is a flowering plant in the dandelion family that is native to Europe and Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues, including digestive problems and inflammation, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium villosum subsp. villosiceps include its ability to reduce pain and swelling, and its use as a diuretic to aid in the removal of excess fluids from the body. Bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
